# TurboCart

> TurboCart is customizable ERP, inventory and POS software for billing, purchases, suppliers, customers, pricing and reports across Windows, Cloud and Mobile.

TurboCart Elite is a standalone Windows billing and inventory edition. TurboCart Pro is a Windows server and client edition for multiple billing systems connected through LAN. TurboCart Platinum is a multi-branch cloud SaaS with 99.99% uptime, dedicated backups, cross-platform access on Android, Windows, Linux and macOS, and a customer-facing mobile e-commerce app for the business.

TurboCart can support grocery, electrical, electronics, computer and IT, automobile-parts inventory, department-store, wholesale and other billing-based businesses. Customers may use the standard product or discuss requirement-based customization for additional fields, workflows, reports and features.

## Verified capabilities

- Fast retail POS billing with barcode, customer, payment and GST calculation workflows.
- Product, inventory, purchase, supplier, pricing, offer, employee and customer management.
- Sales, purchase and stock reporting.
- Local Windows operation with server/client deployment and multiple billing terminals over LAN.
- Elite standalone Windows operation and Pro Windows server/client deployment.
- Platinum cloud SaaS for centralized multi-branch handling.
- 99.99% cloud uptime, subject to applicable service terms and exclusions.
- Cross-platform cloud access on Android, Windows, Linux and macOS.
- Dedicated cloud backup facility.
- A business-owned mobile e-commerce app included with Platinum.
- Requirement-based customization for business-specific billing, inventory, reporting and operational workflows.
